Name: Slower Time in Mines
Author: justrecht
Description:
[b]Slower Time in Mines[/b] is a simple quality-of-life mod that slows down time progression while the player is inside the mines.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Time moves slower when inside the mines
[*] No effect on time outside the mines
[*] Makes mining more relaxed and less stressful
[*] Ideal for exploration, combat, and resource gathering
[/list]

[b]How It Works:[/b]
Time speed is automatically adjusted when you enter the mines and returns to normal once you leave. No manual toggles required.

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*] Works with single-player
[*] Compatible with most gameplay and content mods
[/list]

[b]Notes:[/b]
This mod is designed to be lightweight and unobtrusive, focusing only on improving the mining experience without changing game balance outside the mines.

Enjoy a more relaxed mining experience!
